patterns.note: Full-width sections with a dark background, containing a max-width content area that frequently combines large, dynamic sports imagery with text blocks.
A high-contrast palette featuring a dominant black background, vibrant yellow/gold for primary headings and CTAs, and secondary orange/red accents for highlights.
The initial full-height header, including a prominent yellow navigation bar, transforms into a compact, sticky navigation bar at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the hero content.
Bold, large sans-serif headings in accent colors are used to break up content, contrasted with a more decorative script font for the brand logo.

technique_notes: The design establishes a high-energy visual tone through a deep black background paired with luminous yellow and orange accent colors for headings, calls to action, and key information.

A dynamic header system is employed where a full-height initial header, featuring a prominent yellow navigation bar, transitions into a fixed, slightly reduced-height sticky navigation bar once the user scrolls beyond the main hero content.

Content is presented in vertically stacked sections, each featuring large, action-oriented sports photography, often with text overlays or adjacent descriptive blocks, creating a visually rich and engaging scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) with standard sans-serif body text, and a decorative script for the brand logo.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on buttons and some image containers
design_tokens.spacing: balanced; sections are clearly separated, but content within sections can be quite packed

standout: The site's distinctive use of a very dark, almost black, background combined with extremely vibrant, almost neon-like, yellow and orange accents creates a high-energy, almost aggressive visual impact. The heavy use of dynamic, action-oriented sports imagery further reinforces this energetic feel, making it stand out from more subdued or corporate designs.
